name: Roamr: Drive Log & MPG
subtitle: Auto mileage, commutes, maps
promotionalText: Roamr notices your drives and logs them on a night map, works out MPG from your fill-ups, and tracks your Home and Work commute. Every drive, kept.
description:
Roamr is a logbook for your drives. It notices when a drive starts, maps it on a night map, keeps your trip history and top speeds, and turns your fill-ups into MPG for every vehicle you own.

AUTOMATIC DRIVE LOG
Turn on drive detect and Roamr notices when a drive starts: one tap on the banner or notification records it, and it finishes on its own when you park. Or open the Track tab and tap the big Start drive button. Roamr keeps recording with your phone locked and recovers the drive if the app gets closed.

FUEL AND MPG
Log each fill-up with gallons and price. Roamr works out MPG from your odometer or from the drives it mapped between full tanks, for each vehicle, and shows what you spend on fuel each month.

HOME, WORK AND YOUR COMMUTE
Pin Home, Work and any other place. Pinned chips on the Track tab plan the drive and start recording in one tap, drives between pins are named for you ("Home → Work"), and History shows each commute's typical and fastest time and what it costs in gas.

NIGHT-MAP TRIP HISTORY
Every drive gets a card with its route, grouped by week and day with totals. Open one and the route fills the screen on a night map, colored by speed, with distance, time, average and top speed on top. Switch to day, satellite or hybrid any time.

TOP SPEED AND DRIVING STATS
Miles driven, drive time, average and top speed for the week, month, year or all time, plus records, streaks and distance milestones. GPS spikes are filtered out, so a top speed is one you really drove.

ON THE ROAD
A big speedometer with the posted speed limit (from OpenStreetMap), and every drive saved with its start and end streets. Need directions? Search a place and Roamr guides you there turn by turn.

LIVE ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Distance, time and speed live on screen and in a Live Activity while you drive.

GO TOGETHER
Start a group drive, send the invite link or join code, and everyone shows up live on one map. Each person's drive still lands in their own history.

WATCH, WIDGETS AND SIRI
Start a drive from your wrist and see it live, start one from a Home Screen or Lock Screen widget or Control Center, log gas from a widget, or ask Siri to start a drive.

EXPORT
Share any route as a GPX file to the mapping app you already use.

FREE AND PRO
Recording drives, drive detect, History, Stats, the gas log, pinned places, directions, the Watch app and joining a friend's group are free. Roamr Pro adds starting group drives and the monthly recap. Choose monthly or yearly (with a free first week for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your drives live on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud. Drive detect uses low-power motion signals and only a few seconds of GPS when you seem to be driving. Your position is shared only with the people in a group drive you start or join, and only while it's on.

Watch the road, not your phone: keep your eyes on driving and follow local traffic laws and posted speed limits.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in.

What makes Roamr different: it is a drive logbook that fills itself in. Drive detect notices a drive starting and offers to record it (it never records without a tap), every drive is kept in a night-map history with its top speed, drives between pinned Home and Work places become commute stats, and fill-ups turn the mapped drives into MPG per vehicle (Stats › Fuel & vehicles). Walks or rides recorded by earlier versions stay in History under "Older walks & rides".

To try it: on the Track tab tap Start drive. In the Simulator, Features › Location › Freeway Drive makes a drive. History and Stats fill in as drives are saved.

Location: When In Use records the drive you start; Always keeps recording while the phone is locked and lets Roamr notice a drive starting so it can offer to record it (it never records without asking). Motion: tells driving apart from walking so drive detect only asks when you are in a vehicle.

Go together (group drives): start one with the people button on the Track tab (Pro) or join with a code (free). Members' chosen name and live position are exchanged through the app's CloudKit public database only while the group is on.

Speed limits: road data is downloaded from OpenStreetMap in map tiles of about 4 km; no personal data is sent.

Directions: the Directions button on the Track map searches a place and routes with Apple Maps. Gas & MPG (Settings › Gas & MPG): fill-ups are stored like trips; "Use where I am" takes one location fix to find the nearest station with Apple Maps.

Pro: auto-renewable monthly (com.troydunn.roamr.pro.monthly) and yearly (com.troydunn.roamr.pro.yearly), each with a 1-week free trial as Apple's introductory offer, plus the one-time lifetime unlock (com.troydunn.roamr.pro). Settings › Roamr Pro shows the plans with Restore and Manage Subscription.
